holder-quote: Chaos. Venith Crusland marched a full three hundred [Soldiers] through the crowd, ordering them back, shouting at them to make way. His [Soldiers] forced through towards the King of Destruction and encircled him, ignoring the insults and crowd pushing forwards. There was no violence, which surprised him but not Maresar.
effect-quote: She drew an arrow and shot it into the sky. The people closest to her ducked and covered their ears, flinching back.
